title: Install the shady2k-skills workflow: tracker, backlog gate, commit links, CI
description:
Setup of shady2k-skills 0.82.0 (setup version 0.37.0) in team scope.

DONE WHEN: the four shipped checks run from the main line at setup version 0.37.0; a fresh clone connects with one committed command and its hooks refuse a planted backlog violation and an unlinked commit; CI runs the backlog gate, the commit-link check and the present-documents check on pull requests and pushes to main; the proofs are recorded on this task.

title: Keep claude.md in step with the tree: 44 commits changed files under what it names
description:
The present-documents check (installed with the shady2k-skills setup, .backlog/rules/check-present.mjs) reported older drift at 16684b0: claude.md names paths whose files were added, removed or renamed by 44 commits since the document was last edited. Not fixed in setup: older drift is filed as one debt item, and a change that touches it must keep it true.

Also: this repository has no glossary yet; model-domain creates one when terms settle.

DONE WHEN: the paths claude.md names match the tree (dead references removed or repointed), and the check reports no churn against it.

title: Install the document gate: specs and acceptance evidence checked at each transition
description:
The document gate (check-docs.mjs is already vendored in .backlog/rules/) checks product intent before the first implementation, feature readiness before work starts, evidence tied to the revision at acceptance, and updated current specs before closure.

Found during the shady2k-skills setup; filed with it. Evidence level: records (no protected CI can verify receipts while the owner may push to main directly).

DONE WHEN: a deterministic export from real docs/tasks feeds check-docs.mjs; a wrapper chooses the phase from the actual transition; product/feature/acceptance/close entry points exist and each rejects its planted violations; the integration records it as installed.

title: Run typecheck, lint and tests in CI
description:
CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs only the backlog checks today. The product checks — npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test — are missing from it.

Found during the shady2k-skills setup; filed with it.

DONE WHEN: a CI job runs typecheck, lint and the vitest suite on pull requests and pushes to main, with node 24 and npm ci; a change that cannot touch product code does not owe them.
